description: This Java class 'ImportProductHelper' provides utility methods for preparing product and inventory item data structures and checking for product existence in the database within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to create product and inventory maps and verify if a product already exists by querying the database.

classes.name: ImportProductHelper
classes.description: Utility class for handling product import tasks such as preparing product data maps and checking product existence.

methods.name: prepareProduct
methods.description: Creates a map containing product details with a specified productId, setting default product type, internal name, and variant flags.

methods.name: prepareInventoryItem
methods.description: Creates a map with inventory item details including inventory ID, product association, owner, facility, and quantity information.

methods.name: checkProductExists
methods.description: Checks if a product with the specified productId exists in the database using a Delegator query.
